issue.name: SQL injection
issue.issueBackground: SQL injection vulnerabilities arise when user-controllable data is incorporated into database queries without proper escaping.
issue.issueDetail: The username parameter appears to be vulnerable to SQL injection. The payload admin' OR 1=1-- was submitted and successfully bypassed authentication.

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Reflected XSS arises when an application receives data in an HTTP request and includes that data within the immediate response in an unsafe way.
issue.issueDetail: The q parameter was submitted with the value <script>alert(1)</script>. This input was echoed unmodified in the response.

issue.name: Strict transport security not enforced
issue.issueBackground: The application fails to prevent users from connecting to it over unencrypted connections.
issue.issueDetail: The application does not enforce HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS).

issue.name: Information disclosure - Internal IP
issue.issueBackground: The application discloses its internal IP address.
issue.issueDetail: An internal IP address (192.168.1.100) was found in the response body.
